quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #20
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.

options.text: Flashing yellow
Steady green
Steady red
Flashing red

questions.correctAnswerText: Steady red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light warns you that a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: What should you do when entering a roadway from a private road?

options.text: Blow your horn to warn cars you are entering.
Stop with part of your car on the roadway to alert other drivers.
Drive out fast to merge smoothly with traffic.
Yield the right-of-way to pedestrians and roadway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield the right-of-way to pedestrians and roadway traffic.
questions.explanation: When entering a roadway from a private road or driveway, you must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians and all traffic on the roadway.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Are hidden in the truck driver's blind spots or are too close for the driver to stop and move safely.
Have enough space to travel behind the truck.
Have several car lengths between their vehicle and the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are hidden in the truck driver's blind spots or are too close for the driver to stop and move safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are dangerous areas around trucks or buses where cars cannot be seen by the driver. They are also areas where cars are so close that the truck or bus driver cannot stop or maneuver safely. Being in a "No zone" greatly increases the chance of a crash.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: All traffic must turn.
Turn right at the intersection.
Parking area ahead.
A crossroad is ahead. Be alert for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Be alert for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass, even if it could be dangerous.
Lanes move in opposite directions.
You may not pass.
You may pass if it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. Dashed white lines can be crossed to pass or change lanes when it is safe.

questions.question: If you need to slow down on a slippery road, the first thing you should do is:

options.text: Press your brakes hard.
Take your foot off the gas pedal.
Use your parking brake.
Pump your brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: On a slippery road, first take your foot off the gas pedal. If you need to slow down more, gently squeeze your brakes with slow, steady pressure.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, it is safest to:

options.text: Change your speed often to stay alert.
Drive faster than other traffic.
Drive slower than other traffic.
Drive with the flow of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other vehicles. Always drive with the flow of traffic while staying within the speed limit.

questions.question: If an oncoming car is heading toward you in your lane, you should:

options.text: Blow your horn, steer right, and speed up.
Blow your horn, steer left, and brake.
Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in your lane, blow your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: If a car is coming at you head-on, first honk your horn to get their attention. If they do not move, steer right to escape. Do not steer left because if they correct at the last moment, you will still crash. Brake hard and steadily. Every mile per hour slower reduces the impact force.

questions.question: When entering traffic after being parked at a curb, you should:

options.text: Drive slower than other traffic for 200 feet.
Wait for a large enough gap to get up to the speed of traffic.
Wait for the first two vehicles to pass, then enter the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a large enough gap to get up to the speed of traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging into any traffic, wait for a gap large enough for your car to match the speed of other vehicles.

questions.question: The correct way to make a right turn is to:

options.text: Signal, slow down, and get into the lane closest to the center line before turning.
Signal, slow down, and get into the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach in the right lane, then move toward the center of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and get into the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, use your signal to warn other drivers. Slow down and stay in the right lane, as close to the right curb as safely possible.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks under 18,000 pounds are allowed.
A steep hill is ahead.
A truck stop is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions just ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: Which of these blocks traffic flow?

options.text: Slowing down to look at a collision.
Avoiding unnecessary lane changes.
Using public transportation instead of driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slowing down to look at a collision.
questions.explanation: Slowing down to look at collisions or unusual events causes traffic congestion. Avoid this behavior.

questions.question: If your vehicle has a two-part safety belt system, what should you do?

options.text: Use only the lap belt.
Use both the lap and shoulder belts.
Use only the shoulder belt.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.
questions.explanation: Always wear both the lap belt and shoulder belt. Using only one part greatly reduces your protection. Even if you have an automatic shoulder belt, always buckle your lap belt too.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow to 35 mph or less before the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions just ahead. Speed advisory signs show the safe speed for the upcoming condition.

questions.question: Your vehicle is losing traction because of water on the road. What should you do?

options.text: Drive at a constant speed to gain traction.
Apply the brakes firmly to prevent sliding.
Slow down gradually without using the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gradually without using the brakes.
questions.explanation: When driving in heavy rain, your tires can lose contact with the road and ride on a layer of water. This is called hydroplaning. If this happens, slow down gradually and do not use the brakes.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging.
Drive with caution.
A pedestrian is crossing.
Stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should drive carefully and be alert.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you know no train is coming.
Turn down your radio to listen for an approaching train.
Wait for a flagger to clear you to cross, if one is present.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. Obey all instructions from flaggers if present.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering full parking lots.
Entering road construction areas.
Entering dead-end streets.
Wrong-direction traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-direction traffic on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic only goes one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: You hit a parked vehicle and cannot find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: Call your insurance company when you get home.
Wait for the owner to return.
Leave a note with your name and address on the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a note with your name and address on the vehicle.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked vehicle, you must attach a note with your name, phone number, and address to it.

questions.question: When must you show proof of insurance to law enforcement?

options.text: Only if you are in a collision.
If you are in a collision or stopped for a traffic ticket.
Only if you are stopped and ticketed.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are in a collision or stopped for a traffic ticket.
questions.explanation: You must carry proof of insurance at all times. Show it to an officer when stopped in traffic or involved in a collision.
